title.value: Scenario 1a - EU-PS level 1a: Minimal metadata and empty sections

description.value: The serving system provides an EU-PS for its level 1a test patient, in which all mandatory sections are empty, with an emptyReason and a narrative. The patient is selected by the token entered at test setup. Implementation Guide: https://build.fhir.org/ig/hl7-eu/eps/
